mapper.select: SELECT DOMAIN_ID , COMPANY_CD , COMPANY_NM , COMPANY_ENG_NM , OAUTH_TYPE , LANGUAGE_CD , USE_YN , EP_SSO_TOKEN_CHECK_API_URL , EP_SSO_API_GW_URL , EP_SYSTEM_ID , AUTO_EP_SYNC_YN , EP_EMP_SYNC_API_URL , EP_DEPT_SYNC_API_URL , EP_EMP_DEPT_XREF_SYNC_API_URL , TEMP_DOMAIN_ID , API_AUTH_KEY , UPDATE_USR , UPDATE_DT , CREATE_USR , CREATE_DT FROM COMPANY_MASTER WHERE COMPANY_CD = (SELECT COMPANY_CD FROM EMP_MASTER WHERE EMAIL = #{userId}) AND USE_YN = #{useYn} LIMIT 0, 1

SELECT a.DOMAIN_ID , a.COMPANY_CD , a.EMAIL , a.EMP_NM , a.EMP_ENG_NM , a.EMP_NO , a.POS_CD , a.DEPT_CD , a.EMP_STATUS_CD , a.ENTER_DT , a.QUIT_DT , a.HIDDEN_YN , a.JOB_TEL_NO , a.MOBILE_TEL_NO , a.MANUAL_MNG_YN , a.UPDATE_USR , a.UPDATE_DT , a.CREATE_USR , a.CREATE_DT , b.DEPT_NM , b.DEPT_ENG_NM , c.COMPANY_NM , c.COMPANY_ENG_NM FROM EMP_MASTER a INNER JOIN DEPT_MASTER b ON (a.DOMAIN_ID = b.DOMAIN_ID AND a.COMPANY_CD = b.COMPANY_CD AND a.DEPT_CD = b.DEPT_CD) INNER JOIN COMPANY_MASTER c on (a.DOMAIN_ID = c.DOMAIN_ID AND a.COMPANY_CD = c.COMPANY_CD) WHERE a.EMAIL = #{email} AND a.COMPANY_CD = #{companyCd}
SELECT DOMAIN_ID , COMPANY_CD , EMAIL , AUTHORITY_NAME , UPDATE_USR , UPDATE_DT , CREATE_USR , CREATE_DT FROM EMP_AUTHORITY WHERE EMAIL = #{email} AND COMPANY_CD = #{companyCd}
